en.title: Which Rust request kept a ready Task off the worker?
en.summary: Two requests have identical native addresses in a stripped build. Disassembly checks the JSON call sites, and exact Tokio Task IDs recover the interactive and batch launchers. Moving the worker core away from long serialization lets a ready peer run during that call. GitHub closed the proposal without merging it, and the issue remains open.

zh-CN.title: 哪个 Rust 请求占用了已有任务就绪的 worker？
zh-CN.summary: 剥离符号后，两条请求的原生地址栈相同。反汇编核对 JSON 路径中的调用指令，Tokio Task ID 恢复各自的交互和批处理入口。候选改动让调度器在长请求序列化期间运行另一条已就绪任务。PR 已关闭且未合并，Issue 仍开放。

en.title: Which launch owns the 32 queued streaming chunks?
en.summary: The actual response Task, notification Event and output list join identical coalescer stacks to the original launches. A local patch cuts median coalescer thread CPU from 17.0–17.8 to 9.18–9.81 µs for 32 chunks with late metadata. The issue closed for inactivity.

zh-CN.title: 哪次发起对应 32 个积压的流式输出块？
zh-CN.summary: 用实际响应 Task、通知 Event 和输出列表，把相同的合并执行栈接回各自发起入口。32 个块仅在后段包含元数据时，本地补丁将合并线程 CPU 时间中位数从 17.0–17.8 微秒降到 9.18–9.81 微秒。Issue 因长期无活动而关闭。

en.title: Which onError callback was still pending after capture rethrew?
en.summary: Identical callback stacks join to separate stream starts through the real handler and exception objects. The pinned original test fails with delivery held. The merged test waits for the callback and passes. GitHub still lists the issue as open.

zh-CN.title: capture 抛出异常时，哪条流的 onError 仍在等待？
zh-CN.summary: 用实际处理器与异常对象，把两条相同的回调栈接回各自的流启动点。暂停回调时，修复前的测试断言失败。合入版等待回调后通过。GitHub 上该 issue 仍开放。

en.title: Which agent owned a disconnected model call?
en.summary: In 10.3.0 both follow-up model spans start new traces. The live iterator and original message join each stack to its agent launch. The released 10.4.0 fix preserves both agent traces on .NET 8 and .NET 10.

zh-CN.title: 脱离 trace 的后续模型调用属于哪个 agent？
zh-CN.summary: 10.3.0 中，两条后续模型 span 分别生成新 trace。活跃的枚举器和原始消息把执行栈接回各自的 agent 入口。已发布的 10.4.0 在 .NET 8 和 .NET 10 上都保留了两个 agent 的 trace。

en.title: Which handles created the background metrics Tasks?
en.summary: Identical flush stacks join across threads to the chat and embedding handle initializers. At 128 idle handles, a shared Task reduces router-thread CPU from 40.3–42.2 ms to 17.3 ms per 850 ms window. A separate 16-handle control preserves all counter deltas with one wake-up instead of 16.

zh-CN.title: 哪些部署句柄创建了后台指标任务？
zh-CN.summary: 两条相同的刷新栈跨线程接回聊天和嵌入句柄的初始化。有 128 个空闲句柄时，共享 Task 让每 850 毫秒窗口的路由线程 CPU 时间从 40.3–42.2 降至 17.3 毫秒。独立的 16 句柄对照中，唤醒次数从 16 降到 1，逐句柄计数一致。

en.title: Which requests queued at the Rust tokenizer?
en.summary: Two identical tokenizer worker stacks join to separate HTTP Tasks and launchers. With eight 8,070-token requests, the median burst maximum wait falls from 102.7–103.1 ms to 12.5–12.7 ms. The base with four workers matches the open proposal and all token IDs agree.

zh-CN.title: 哪些请求在 Rust 分词线程前排队？
zh-CN.summary: 两条相同的分词执行栈接回各自的 HTTP Task 和发起入口。每轮 8 条请求，每条 8070 个 token，最慢排队时间的中位数从 102.7–103.1 降至 12.5–12.7 毫秒。原版手动设为四线程时与开放 PR 的表现接近，所有 token ID 一致。

en.title: Which cold model load waited behind the replica lock?
en.summary: The base serializes two distinct cold model loads. The open PR overlaps 45.1 ms of loader work, bringing pair time from 111.4 ms to 66.2 ms in the component replay. Live loader Tasks and their creating requests distinguish the two identical loader stacks.

zh-CN.title: 哪次模型冷加载在等待副本锁？
zh-CN.summary: 原版把两个不同模型的首次加载串行执行。开放的 PR 让两次加载重叠 45.1 毫秒，组件实验中两条请求的总耗时从 111.4 降到 66.2 毫秒。核对加载 Task 及创建它的请求，区分了两条相同的加载栈。

en.title: Which requests repeat the Kimi special-token lookup?
en.summary: Two identical decode stacks join to separate frontend Tasks by their actual packet rows. The old tokenizer repeats the original property lookup 20 times per traced row. With special-token filtering, the merged cache reduces the three-packet, 1,024-row CPU comparison from 4.27–4.37 s to 51.7–52.2 ms.

zh-CN.title: 哪些请求在重复计算 Kimi 的特殊 token？
zh-CN.summary: 用数据包中的实际行位置，把两条相同的解码栈接回各自的前端 Task。旧版对每行重复执行原始属性计算 20 次。启用特殊 token 过滤时，合入的缓存使 1024 行、三批的 CPU 耗时从 4.27–4.37 秒降至 51.7–52.2 毫秒。

en.title: Where did two equally slow Ray Serve first replies spend their time?
en.summary: Identical enqueue stacks join to two request launchers. Both first replies take about 46 ms. One stream spends about 40 ms in Ray output batching. The other spends about 33 ms below the engine boundary. A local patch records the engine interval directly for percentiles.

zh-CN.title: 两个首包耗时相同的 Ray Serve 请求各慢在哪里？
zh-CN.summary: 相同的入队栈分别接回两个请求入口。两条流首包都约 46 毫秒，其中一条约 40 毫秒耗在 Ray 输出批处理，另一条约 33 毫秒耗在引擎侧。本地补丁直接记录引擎侧区间用于计算分位数。

en.title: Which Dynamo worker waited for its first canary?
en.summary: Actual Tokio Tasks and registration notifiers join identical timer stacks to two worker registrations. At the default ten-second interval, the successful worker reaches Ready in 10.004 s on the base and 4.8 ms on the open PR. The other worker stays NotReady until its retry succeeds.

zh-CN.title: Dynamo 哪个 worker 在等待首次就绪检查？
zh-CN.summary: 实际 Tokio Task 和注册通知对象把相同的计时器执行栈接回两次注册。在默认 10 秒配置下，首次检查成功的 worker 从 10.004 秒降至 4.8 毫秒。另一个 worker 仍需等重试成功才会就绪。

en.title: Which Dynamo requests pay for repeated token-prefix processing?
en.summary: Actual Tasks and dispatch Handles join two identical vLLM parser stacks to their Dynamo launchers. In the 16,384-chunk component replay, the open PR reduces median frontend thread CPU from 1,097–1,100 ms to 243–245 ms, with matching streamed outputs and usage.

zh-CN.title: 哪些 Dynamo 请求承担了重复 token 前缀处理的 CPU 开销？
zh-CN.summary: 实际 Task 和调度 Handle 将相同的 vLLM 解析执行栈接回各自的 Dynamo 发起入口。16384 段的组件实验中，候选 PR 将前端线程 CPU 时间中位数从 1097–1100 毫秒降至 243–245 毫秒，流式输出和统计一致。

en.title: Which HTTP streams incur a Ray Serve deployment hop?
en.summary: Matching the actual response body and Ray result recovers both HTTP origins from identical read stacks. Grouping after the first event reduces inter-deployment results from 2,048 to 288 while keeping all 64 events per stream in order.

zh-CN.title: 哪些 HTTP 流经过了 Ray Serve 的跨部署转发？
zh-CN.summary: 用实际响应体和 Ray 结果把相同的读取栈接回两个 HTTP 路由。首个事件立即发送，此后分组使跨部署交接从 2048 次降到 288 次，每条流的 64 个事件均保持原有顺序。

en.title: Which startup Task launched each background KV pin?
en.summary: The two pinning threads have identical stacks. Each joins to the Task that started it. In a 1 GiB A100 loopback run with CUDA graphs, the draft starts pinning after graph capture and returns the first completion 292 ms before KV connector readiness.

zh-CN.title: 每次后台 KV 内存注册由哪个启动 Task 发起？
zh-CN.summary: 两条后台注册线程的执行栈相同，分别拼回发起它们的 Task。A100 回环服务配置 1 GiB 缓存并启用 CUDA Graph 时，候选补丁在图捕获后开启后台注册，首条结果早于 KV 连接器就绪 292 毫秒。

en.title: Which TEI pipeline waits for a ready-batch slot?
en.summary: Actual Tokio Task IDs and channels join identical waits to separate launches. The local option increases ready batches from one to four during a controlled pause. Real CPU throughput changes by about one percent in opposite directions across the two batch regimes.

zh-CN.title: TEI 哪条推理流水线在等预取通道空位？
zh-CN.summary: 实际 Tokio Task ID 和通道将相同的等待栈接回不同发起入口。受控暂停期间，本地选项将预取批数从 1 提到 4。真实 CPU 测试中，两种批次条件下的吞吐分别变化约 1%，方向相反。

en.title: Which benchmark runs counted rejected streams as successes?
en.summary: Task joins connect identical client execution stacks to the evaluation and calibration launches. Each rejected response contributes eight tokens before the fix. The open patch changes the total from four successes and 21 tokens to two successes and five tokens.

zh-CN.title: 哪些基准运行把被拒绝的流计成了成功？
zh-CN.summary: 实际 Task 将相同的客户端执行栈接回评估与校准的发起入口。修复前两个被拒响应各被计入 8 个 token。开放的候选修复将汇总从 4 个成功、21 个 token 修正为 2 个成功、5 个 token。

en.title: Which request owns each generator's backpressure updates?
en.summary: The same driver stack joins to the catalog and research Tasks by the actual generator and executor WorkItem. The local inline patch halves the updates for 32 ready pairs, from 64 to 32. Both builds return the expected rows through the public dataset API.

zh-CN.title: 各数据流的背压更新来自哪个请求？
zh-CN.summary: 按实际生成器和执行器 WorkItem，把相同的驱动线程栈接回目录和研究 Task。本地内联补丁将 32 对已就绪数据的更新数从 64 条减到 32 条，两版通过公开 Dataset API 返回相同的行。

en.title: Which Spring AI request owns each scheduled tool callback?
en.summary: Identical Reactor scheduler stacks join back to the original tool registrations and application requests. The open proposal's async path still subscribes to one tool at a time. The local opt-in patch reduces the three-tool batch median from about 242 to 121 ms and keeps model response order.

zh-CN.title: Spring AI 各次调度的工具回调属于哪个请求？
zh-CN.summary: 两条相同的 Reactor 调度栈分别拼回工具登记栈和应用请求。开放 PR 的异步路径仍逐个订阅。本地补丁显式启用并发后，将三个工具的批次耗时中位数由约 242 毫秒降到 121 毫秒，同时保留返回给模型的结果顺序。

en.title: Which model launch owns each idle CPU loop?
en.summary: The execution stacks are identical. Each engine token connects the idle sample to future creation and then to the catalog or search launch. Both scheduler threads use about one core before the merged fix. Afterwards neither advances by one 10 ms CPU tick in the idle window.

zh-CN.title: 各条占用 CPU 的空闲循环由哪个模型入口启动？
zh-CN.summary: 两条执行栈相同。按引擎标识将每条空闲采样接回 Future 创建栈，再接回目录或搜索入口。修复前两个调度线程各占用约一个核，修复后空闲窗口内两者都没有增加一个 10 毫秒 CPU 计量单位。

en.title: Which session paid for repeated prefill?
en.summary: Both timings arrive on one Go worker with identical frames. Two marked joins recover the channel submission and the goroutine launch for each session. On one CPU runner slot the local option reduces repeat evaluations from 494–512 tokens to four.

zh-CN.title: 哪次会话承担了重复预填充的开销？
zh-CN.summary: 两条计时在同一个 Go worker 上读取，执行栈相同。两处标注的拼接分别找回 channel 提交栈和 goroutine 的创建栈。在单槽 CPU 对照中，本地选项把每次重复预填充从 494 至 512 个 token 降到 4 个。

en.title: Which requests produced the delayed iteration timings?
en.summary: The same timing-read stack handles both snapshots from a later stats-only reply. Joining each snapshot to the scheduled Request and its submitting Task restores both callers. The merged timer measures worker-stream intervals when enabled.

zh-CN.title: 延迟上报的迭代计时各属于哪个请求？
zh-CN.summary: 同一条读计时的执行栈处理了后来随统计包送出的两条记录。将实际快照接回调度的 Request，再接回提交 Task，可以找回各自的调用者。已合并的计时路径在启用时测量工作线程上的流事件区间。

en.title: Which ready audio replies wait for idle replicas?
en.summary: The paired joins recover both replica readers and their matching request launches. With four additional idle replicas, the current legacy loop delays the slower reply by a median 90.55 ms in the CPU fixture. The event-driven default routes it in 1.26 ms.

zh-CN.title: 哪些已就绪的音频回复在等空闲副本？
zh-CN.summary: 两组拼接找回两个副本的读取协程及其对应的请求创建栈。CPU 对照加入四个额外空闲副本，当前旧轮询路径发送较慢回复的耗时中位数为 90.55 毫秒，默认事件驱动路径为 1.26 毫秒。

en.title: Which requests waited before the router read the packet?
en.summary: Both reply stacks join to their own callers. The open PR measures routing after receipt. A local patch measures the preceding transfer and separates a controlled 25 ms wait from work in the router with both IPC codecs.

zh-CN.title: 哪些请求在路由器读取消息前等待？
zh-CN.summary: 两条回复执行栈分别接回各自的创建栈。开放的 PR 测量收到消息之后的路由处理。本地补丁测量此前的传输，在两种 IPC 编码下均能把夹具加入的 25 毫秒等待和路由处理区分开。

en.title: Which vLLM requests arrived after the scheduling pass?
en.summary: The joined stacks recover the interactive and batch submitters for two identical scheduler observations. The open PR reports one capacity waiter where the base reports three. Both report three after the next scheduling pass, which has now examined the two new requests.

zh-CN.title: 哪些 vLLM 请求在一轮调度之后才到达？
zh-CN.summary: 将相同的调度器执行栈分别接回交互和批量请求的提交协程。调度器尚未处理新请求时，原版报告 3 个容量等待，候选修复报告 1 个。下一轮调度检查过两个新请求后，两版都报告 3 个。

en.title: Which request occupied the multimodal worker?
en.summary: Matching executor submissions identifies which document render holds the worker while the thumbnail waits. On six large local images, sharing the two processes' result tensors reduces median time from 181–202 ms to 165–173 ms across two runs. Two threads take 95–97 ms in the same comparison.

zh-CN.title: 哪个请求占用了多模态工作线程？
zh-CN.summary: 核对实际提交对象后，可以确认缩略图等待期间占用工作线程的是文档请求。两轮本地六张大图对照的双进程耗时中位数从按值传输的 181–202 毫秒降到共享张量的 165–173 毫秒。同组双线程对照为 95–97 毫秒。

en.title: Which batches enter after a live limit change?
en.summary: The open proposal changes the batch limit without replacing the replica. Matching request Futures shows which batch enters after older work drains and which enters when the limit rises again.

zh-CN.title: 热更新后哪些批次获得了执行名额？
zh-CN.summary: 仍开放的提案在同一个副本上修改并发上限。核对请求 Future 后，可以分辨哪批在旧任务结束后进入，哪批在上限调高后进入。

en.title: Which query delayed an already-created task?
en.summary: The second synchronous read occupies about 202 ms of the first query’s downstream Task wait. The open fix lets native async retrieval yield the event loop. A sync-only retriever still waits on the loop.

zh-CN.title: 哪个查询拖延了已创建的下游任务？
zh-CN.summary: 第二次同步读取占了第一个下游 Task 等待时间中的约 202 毫秒。仍开放的提案让支持异步的检索器释放事件循环。只支持同步的检索器仍在事件循环上等待。

en.title: Which request supplied a later batch’s model ID?
en.summary: Two handling Tasks join to the queue Task from the first request. Reversing the first model reverses the affected selection. The fixed release returns all twelve expected model IDs and items.

zh-CN.title: 后续批次沿用了哪个请求的模型 ID？
zh-CN.summary: 两个批处理 Task 都拼回首个请求创建的队列。交换首个模型后，选错的模型也随之改变。修复版的十二条结果均返回正确的模型 ID 和输入项。

en.title: Which sessions received the tokenizer worker results?
en.summary: Identical collector stacks join through separate callbacks to the original request Tasks. Both drafts return exact reference token IDs. The waiting draft delivers each result to its own Future and reduces callback delay in the local CPU comparison.

zh-CN.title: 分词结果回到了哪个会话？
zh-CN.summary: 两条相同的收集栈通过各自回调接回原请求 Task。两版草案的 token ID 都与参考结果一致。使用 await 的草案通过各自 Future 交付结果，并缩短本地 CPU 对照中的回调延迟。

en.title: Which requests preprocessed images on the loop?
en.summary: Identical Qwen2-VL stacks lead to two separate raw requests. The merged change moves preprocessing to a renderer worker. The median queued callback delay falls from 30.3 to 0.135 ms in the CPU fixture.

zh-CN.title: 哪些请求在事件循环上预处理图片？
zh-CN.summary: 相同的 Qwen2-VL 执行栈接回两条独立的原始输入请求。上游修复将预处理移到 renderer 工作线程。CPU 实验中的回调延迟中位数从 30.3 毫秒降到 0.135 毫秒。

en.title: Which input conversion delayed another UDF?
en.summary: Separate launches lead to the formatter that holds the actor loop and the UDF waiting to resume. The open proposal moves formatting to a worker thread. The median queued-completion delay falls from 2.50 to 0.082 ms in the CPU comparison.

zh-CN.title: 哪个输入转换拖延了另一个 UDF？
zh-CN.summary: 占住 Actor 事件循环的格式转换与等待恢复的 UDF 分别来自两个入口。仍开放的提案将转换移到工作线程。CPU 对照中，从完成回调入队到 UDF 恢复的中位数从 2.50 毫秒降至 0.082 毫秒。

en.title: Which receivers delivered the pre-tokenized replies?
en.summary: The parent revision delivers both replies through the same receiver Task. The merged change restores two separate receiver Tasks. The four joins recover both receiver launchers and the corresponding request starts.

zh-CN.title: 预分词请求的结果由哪个接收任务交付？
zh-CN.summary: 修复前两个结果都由同一个接收 Task 交付。上游合并后恢复为两个独立的接收 Task。四处拼接分别找回两个接收任务和两个请求的创建入口。

en.title: Which work delayed the ready receiver?
en.summary: Two tokenizer stacks join to separate launchers. Both run after the real receiver Future is ready. Moving the same work to threads changes the median ready-to-resume interval from 32.6 to 0.050 ms in the CPU fixture.

zh-CN.title: 哪些工作推迟了已就绪的接收任务？
zh-CN.summary: 两个分词执行栈分别接回各自的入口。它们都在实际接收 Future 就绪后运行。CPU 实验将相同工作移到工作线程，从就绪到恢复的中位数从 32.6 降到 0.050 毫秒。

en.title: Which benchmark requests waited before HTTP timing?
en.summary: Matching the Task joins the semaphore wait and HTTP entry to each request. In the capped fixture, the merged metrics show about 287 ms of queueing and 389 ms of queue-inclusive latency. The endpoint timer still reports about 102 ms.

zh-CN.title: 哪些请求在 HTTP 计时前已经排队？
zh-CN.summary: 实际 Task 把 semaphore 等待与 HTTP 入口拼回同一请求。并发限制为 1 时，合并修复新增约 287 毫秒的排队计时，含排队延迟约 389 毫秒，原端到端指标仍约 102 毫秒。

en.title: Which requests lost their final chunks at shutdown?
en.summary: Two frontend channels drop the final chunks on the affected launcher. Matching the actual collector and error objects connects each output-handler failure to its request. Both open proposals deliver both final chunks in the local comparison.

zh-CN.title: 哪些请求在停机时丢失了最后一块？
zh-CN.summary: 原版启动器让两个前端通道都丢失末块。用实际 collector 和异常对象，可以将每次输出处理异常接回对应的请求。两个开放提案在本地对照中均交付两条请求的末块。

en.title: Which calls rebuilt the Mistral lexer?
en.summary: Two identical construction stacks join to their caller Tasks. A bounded local cache reuses the lexer shape and preserves the tested parser events. Median warm constructor time falls from 71.5 to 0.14 ms on v0.30.0.

zh-CN.title: 哪些调用重复构建 Mistral 词法器？
zh-CN.summary: 两条相同的构建栈分别接回发起任务。本地有界缓存复用词法器结构，解析事件一致。v0.30.0 的热态构建耗时中位数从 71.5 毫秒降到 0.14 毫秒。

en.title: Which tasks ran the per-chunk checks?
en.summary: The receive samples join to separate stream-body Tasks and their ASGI requests. The merged fix reduces the observed checks from seven to one per eight-chunk stream. The HTTP fixture's median throughput rises from 23,507 to 47,340 chunks/s.

zh-CN.title: 哪些任务逐块检查断连？
zh-CN.summary: 接收样本分别接回两条流的输出 Task 和 ASGI 请求。合并修复后，每条八块输出流的检查次数从 7 次降到 1 次。HTTP 对照实验的吞吐中位数从 23,507 升到 47,340 块/秒。

en.title: Which producer held the first chunk?
en.summary: The first-yield stacks join to the two batch Tasks and their bound inputs. The first chunk arrives after 12 yields on the original planner and after one yield with the local patch. At 24 chunks, a separate single-node test measures about 24 MiB of live Arrow allocations above UDF entry on the stock path and about 4 MiB with the patch.

zh-CN.title: 哪个生产任务延迟了首块交付？
zh-CN.summary:
两条首次 yield 的执行栈各自接回对应的批次 Task 和输入。原版等第一批生成全部 12 块才交付第一块，本地补丁在生成第一块后就交付，且保留 36 行结果的顺序。

另一组单节点实验输出 24 块时，Actor 内 Arrow 池的活跃分配峰值相对入口从约 24 MiB 降到约 4 MiB。

en.title: Which request blocked the event loop?
en.summary: Two call paths reach the same queue poll. The affected poll joins back to its request Task, and the repaired poll reaches that Task through its executor WorkItem. With the merged fix, a separate Task runs 30 times during polling and the video bytes match.

zh-CN.title: 哪次请求阻塞了事件循环？
zh-CN.summary: 两条入口共用同一个队列轮询函数。受影响版本的轮询接回请求 Task，修复后则通过执行器 WorkItem 接回该 Task。合并修复后，独立任务在轮询期间运行了 30 次，返回的视频字节一致。

en.title: Which queue serialized three batches?
en.summary: All 24 request Futures were enqueued before the first batch finished. Three execution stacks connect to one queue Task created in the first enqueue. Enabling concurrency on the fixed release gives each batch a separate Task.

zh-CN.title: 哪个队列串行执行了三批请求？
zh-CN.summary: 第一批完成前，24 条请求都已入队。三个执行栈接回首个请求入队时创建的同一个队列 Task。修复版打开并发后，每批各有一个执行 Task。

en.title: Which calls rebuilt the vocabulary?
en.summary: Two identical worker stacks connect through their executor WorkItems to separate tokenizer callers. The affected code rebuilds the mapping twelve or six times per six-token input. The fixed release performs all conversions without rebuilding it.

zh-CN.title: 哪些调用触发了词表重建？
zh-CN.summary: 按实际 WorkItem 将相同的工作线程栈接回两个调用者。受影响版本处理两条六词请求时分别重建 12 次和 6 次词表。修复版完成相同的转换，重建次数归零。

en.title: Which requests launched the prompt producers?
en.summary: The proposal overlaps prompts in a streaming SGLang completion. The actual producer Task and queue tuple recover the requesting coroutine even when two requests stream the same prompts.

zh-CN.title: 哪些请求创建了这些 prompt 生成协程？
zh-CN.summary: 候选修复让同一 SGLang 请求中的 prompt 重叠执行。通过实际 Task 和队列元组，即使两个请求的 prompt 相同，也能分别找回生成协程所属的请求。

en.title: Which prompts used the slow tokenizer in a shared batch?
en.summary: Four requests share one executor item and the same physical stack. The actual input object and result Future connect each worker observation to its request. In a CPU component test, the unmerged proposal reduces median batch time from 141 to 43 ms.

zh-CN.title: 同一批次里，哪些请求走了慢速分词？
zh-CN.summary: 四个请求共用一个线程池工作项，物理栈也相同。通过实际输入对象和结果 Future，可以把每次观测接回各自的请求。CPU 组件对照中，未合并的候选补丁将整批中位耗时从 141 毫秒降至 43 毫秒。

en.title: Which task merged the swapped features?
en.summary: Matching the live Task, coroutine and frame restores the creation site for two identical merge stacks. The selected records preserve the exact values each affected batch forwarded. The open PR restored all feature bindings in the local control.

zh-CN.title: 哪个批处理任务交换了特征？
zh-CN.summary: 匹配实际的 Task、协程和协程帧，把两个相同的合并栈分别接到创建位置。记录也保留了每批实际传入和传出的参数。仍开放的 PR 在本地对照中恢复了全部特征绑定。

en.title: Which route submitted each detokenization call?
en.summary: The merged repair runs streaming detokenization on renderer threads. Matching the exact executor WorkItem separates identical worker stacks into chat and completion submissions and restores both stream Task creation stacks.

zh-CN.title: 每次流式解码由哪个路由提交？
zh-CN.summary: 已合并的修复在渲染器线程池执行流式解码。用线程池的实际 WorkItem，可以把相同的工作线程栈分别接回聊天与文本补全请求的提交位置及各自的创建栈。

en.title: Which receiver unblocks each control call?
en.summary: Cold pause and continue calls each leave one unread broadcast. In the warm controls, the exact Future connects the waiting call to the broadcast receiver. The processing stack then leads back to the receive-loop creation.

zh-CN.title: 哪个接收任务解除控制请求的等待？
zh-CN.summary: 冷启动的暂停和继续操作各留下一个未读广播。启动接收循环后，按实际 Future 可找到对应的广播接收者，再从执行栈接回接收循环的创建位置。

en.title: Which tasks wrote rows after their blocks ended?
en.summary: The two block managers send end markers before their batch Tasks write rows. The exact Task used in each failed await connects the later row write to its manager and creation stack.

zh-CN.title: 分块结束后，哪些任务仍在写入数据？
zh-CN.summary: 两个分块管理协程先发出结束标记，批任务随后才写入。用等待失败时见到的 Task 对象，可以把后续写入接回对应的管理协程和创建栈。

en.title: Who borrowed each connection that kept the pool open?
en.summary: Both acquiring Tasks have been collected when shutdown gets stuck. Stock Task stacks and the allocation trace identify two pending release Futures at the same library line. CoroPerf matches each actual Future to its acquisition and recovers the application caller.

zh-CN.title: 哪些请求借出了让连接池无法关闭的连接？
zh-CN.summary: 关闭连接池卡住时，两个原始请求的 Task 都已回收。任务栈与分配追踪显示两个归还 Future 都来自同一行库代码。CoroPerf 根据实际的 Future 找到各自的连接获取记录，再接回应用调用者。

en.title: Who filled the cache entry that failed later?
en.summary: Both reads fail at the same library line after both writer Tasks have been collected. The allocation traces also match. CoroPerf uses each actual FrozenResult to connect the failing reader to its original writer.

zh-CN.title: 后来读取失败的缓存条目由谁写入？
zh-CN.summary: 两个写入 Task 已被回收，两次读取在同一行库代码报错，分配栈也相同。CoroPerf 根据实际的 FrozenResult，将每条读取异常接回原始写入者。

en.title: Which cancellation reached the final error?
en.summary: The target accepts two cancellation requests. With a stalled loop, the earlier cancelled Future supplies the final exception and the external message disappears. CoroPerf links the two request stacks to the observed Task and Future state.

zh-CN.title: 哪一次取消产生了最终异常？
zh-CN.summary: 同一个 Task 接受两次取消。事件循环停顿时，最终异常来自先前已取消的 Future，外部请求的消息丢失。CoroPerf 用实际 Task 和 Future 的状态接回两条取消请求栈。

en.title: Who first raised the error injected into the async generator?
en.summary: The affected build drops the original make_exception frame. Both caught errors have identical tracebacks. Matching the exception object across producer and receiver Tasks restores the application launcher for each error.

zh-CN.title: 注入异步生成器的异常最初由谁发起？
zh-CN.summary: 受影响版本丢失 make_exception，两条接收回溯相同。匹配生产者与接收者之间的同一个异常对象，可以把每条回溯分别接回原始发起者。

en.title: Who evicted the result and who stayed waiting?
en.summary: All 20 cache computations finish, while 15 callers remain blocked on the affected release. The same result Future connects each eviction to its completion callback and waiting Task. Joining the two Task stacks through their dispatch Handles recovers the original callers.

zh-CN.title: 谁淘汰了缓存结果，谁仍在等待？
zh-CN.summary: 在受影响版本中，20 个缓存计算都结束了，15 个请求仍在等待。用同一个结果 Future 对上每次淘汰、完成回调和等待中的 Task，再通过两个实际调度 Handle 把各自的执行栈接回原始调用者。

en.title: Which feature launched the interceptor?
en.summary: Stock Dart 3.14.0 shows testFuture as an async frame. The original feature remains absent. Matching the actual Future listener callback to its binding stack recovers featureA or featureB even when the second launch reaches the interceptor first.

zh-CN.title: 哪个功能入口发起了拦截器调用？
zh-CN.summary: Dart 3.14.0 的原生异步栈能追到 testFuture，但两次调用都缺少原始入口。CoroPerf 将实际执行的 Future 监听器回调接回绑定栈，即使后发起的调用先到达，也能找回对应的 featureA 或 featureB。

en.title: Which unsafeRun initiated each worker failure?
en.summary: The reported runtime produces the same failure trace for two fibers apart from their IDs. Java thread snapshots show both unsafeRun calls. Matching the actual FiberContext restores the particular caller and source line for each failure.

zh-CN.title: 两条失败栈分别对应哪次 unsafeRun？
zh-CN.summary: 在报告版本中，两条失败追踪只有 Fiber ID 不同。Java 线程快照能看到两个 unsafeRun。CoroPerf 用实际 FiberContext 对象，把每条失败栈接回具体调用者和源码行。

en.title: Which interceptor led to the worker that lost the request ID?
en.summary: Both RPCs use the same method and payload. In the reported build, two worker threads read None through identical stacks. The active WorkItem links each read to its submission. Matching the exact handler then restores the interceptor route on the asyncio thread.

zh-CN.title: 请求 ID 丢失时，工作线程来自哪条拦截器路径？
zh-CN.summary: 两条 RPC 使用同一个方法和相同载荷。在报告使用的构建中，两个工作线程通过相同的栈读到 None。CoroPerf 用实际执行的 WorkItem 接回提交栈，再用处理器对象找回 asyncio 线程上的拦截器路径。

en.title: Who started the tasks that outlived gather?
en.summary: The official patch corrects the list of current waiters. After the shared dispatch callback runs, built-in diagnostics omit both original launchers. Recording the actual Handle at dispatch connects each surviving Task back to its call_soon caller.

zh-CN.title: gather 失败后，是谁发起了还在运行的任务？
zh-CN.summary: 官方补丁修正了当前等待者列表。两个任务经过同一个回调后，原生诊断里都缺少最初的发起者。CoroPerf 记录创建 Task 时实际运行的 Handle，把每个存活任务连回各自的 call_soon 调用者。

en.title: Which reads failed before stream cleanup?
en.summary: Two tasks have the same final traceback through wait_closed. Keeping the first raise and linking it to the actual Task creation stack restores the failed readexactly or readuntil and its original caller.

zh-CN.title: 流清理之前，真正失败的是哪次读取？
zh-CN.summary: 两个任务最终都留下经过 wait_closed 的同一条异常栈。CoroPerf 保存首次抛出时的执行栈，并拼回匹配的 Task 创建栈，从而恢复失败的 readexactly 或 readuntil 及其原始调用者。

en.title: What called the resumed Task?
en.summary: On the tested CoreCLR draft, direct await recovers its caller in the live async stack. Both synchronous forwarders disappear after resumption. A TPL execution interval assigns each worker observation to its Task, and the recorded creation stack restores LaunchInventory or LaunchProfile. All eight checks matched the actual Task IDs.

zh-CN.title: 恢复执行的 Task 由谁发起？
zh-CN.summary: 在测试的 CoreCLR 草案中，直接 await 的实时异步栈能显示调用者。经过同步 Task 转发后，两条恢复栈都缺少发起者。CoroPerf 用 TPL 执行区间确定采样属于哪个 Task，再拼回创建栈里的 LaunchInventory 或 LaunchProfile。8 次核对均与实际 Task ID 一致。

en.title: Which caller submitted the task still in cleanup?
en.summary: The bridge Future reports cancellation while the loop Task is still pending. After the submission callback runs, stock task diagnostics display the same cleanup for both tasks. Matching the actual Task and bridge Future at _chain_future recovers the original caller on the submitting thread.

zh-CN.title: 是谁提交了仍在清理的任务？
zh-CN.summary: 外层 Future 已取消，循环线程上的 Task 仍未结束。提交回调结束后，原生任务诊断显示相同的清理路径。匹配 _chain_future 接收到的实际 Task 和 Future，就能跨线程接回原始提交者。

en.title: Recovery across garbage collection
en.summary: The constructor stack starts on a timer worker. The token stored in the state machine joins the call from Program.Main to the resumed Foo invocation at A..ctor. A follow-up matched that initiation in three normal and three forced-compaction runs.

zh-CN.title: 跨垃圾回收的创建记录
zh-CN.summary: 构造函数的栈起于计时器工作线程。状态机里存的令牌把 Program.Main 的创建现场和 Foo 恢复后进入 A..ctor 的现场连起来。后续的三次正常运行和三次强制压缩式垃圾回收对照均找回了发起者。

en.title: Which call failed?
en.summary: Two calls carried the same message, and the server reversed the reply order. Both failure stacks ended at the same library location. Matching the Kotlin Job identifies the distinct launch sites for the profile and inventory calls. An independent check compared the exception objects by reference.

zh-CN.title: 失败来自哪次调用
zh-CN.summary: 两次调用携带相同的消息，服务端又反转了回复顺序，两个失败栈也落在同一库代码位置。匹配 Kotlin Job 后，可以分别定位个人资料和库存查询的启动位置。独立对照用引用相等核对了异常对象。

en.title: Recovering a caller removed by tail-call optimization
en.summary: After a dispatcher switch, exception recovery and the live DebugProbes dump both omit the tail caller on the tested Kotlin release. CoroPerf uses the actual DispatchedCoroutine Job to connect the worker's failing invokeSuspend to either profileCaller or inventoryCaller. All 16 attributions across two batches match the independent check.

zh-CN.title: 找回被尾调用优化省略的调用者
zh-CN.summary: 在测试版本中，切换调度器后，异常栈恢复和 DebugProbes 实时转储都缺少尾调用者。CoroPerf 用同一个 DispatchedCoroutine Job，把 worker 上抛出异常的 invokeSuspend 接回实际的 profileCaller 或 inventoryCaller。两批共 16 次归属均通过独立核对。

en.title: Who started the trace-less waiting fibers?
en.summary: In the original Play app, even full stock tracing leaves the dispatcher workers' WAITING rows empty. Matching each IOFiber at wait registration to its creation, then following its creator edge, leads back to dispatcher initialization at AppLoader.scala:32.

zh-CN.title: 谁启动了无栈的等待 fiber？
zh-CN.summary: 在原始 Play 应用里，开启完整追踪后，Dispatcher worker 的 WAITING 记录依然没有栈帧。CoroPerf 用同一 IOFiber 对象把等待登记接回构造，再沿创建者边找到 AppLoader.scala:32 的 Dispatcher 初始化。

en.title: Which caller spent longer waiting for I/O?
en.summary: Python's async-aware sampler distinguishes the two suspended Tasks and shows which waited longer. CoroPerf measures each actual suspension and follows the dispatch Handle back to the original caller.

zh-CN.title: 哪个调用者等 I/O 等得更久？
zh-CN.summary: Python 的异步采样器可以区分两个等待中的 Task，并显示哪个等得更久。CoroPerf 测量各自的实际挂起时间，再沿调度 Handle 找回原始调用者。

en.title: Which exited producer left each waiter blocked?
en.summary: Both singleflight producers exit while all four waiters remain blocked. Go's trace records the launchers and exits. The shared call and each registered result channel connect a specific waiter to the producer it depended on.

zh-CN.title: 哪个已经退出的生产者让这个调用一直等待？
zh-CN.summary: 两个 singleflight 生产者都已退出，四个等待者仍在阻塞。Go trace 记录了发起者和退出事件。沿实际登记的结果通道和共享调用，可以把各个等待者接回它依赖的生产者。

en.title: Whose handshake timed out while the stream processed another result?
en.summary: The server sends a reply before its simulated deadline. The stream polls that handshake again only after finishing the first item's work. Poll intervals and the actual result object connect the stalled handshake and the work ahead of it to two distinct callers.

zh-CN.title: 流处理一条结果时，哪个调用者的握手超时了？
zh-CN.summary: 服务端在模拟时限前发出回复。流等第一项工作完成后才再次轮询该握手。CoroPerf 使用实际轮询区间和结果对象，把超时的握手和占住消费循环的工作分别接回两个调用者。

en.title: Who launched each coroutine at the reused address?
en.summary: Four coroutine lifetimes share one frame address and one worker stack, even with frame types restored in GDB. Machine-code dataflow identifies the live frame. CoroPerf connects its current lifetime to the earlier creation stack that names the original caller.

zh-CN.title: 同一个帧地址上的协程分别由谁发起？
zh-CN.summary: 恢复 GDB 可读的帧类型后，四次观测仍然显示相同的帧地址和工作线程栈。CoroPerf 从机器指令的数据流恢复活动帧，再用它当前的生命周期接回记录原始调用者的创建栈。

en.title: Which caller accounts for the repeated rethrows?
en.summary: Fourteen identical rethrow stacks interleave on one worker. CoroPerf matches the exception object to the fault of its root Task. In the selected run, that attributes twelve rethrows to LaunchProfile and two to LaunchInventory.

zh-CN.title: 重复重抛分别来自哪个调用者？
zh-CN.summary: 同一个工作线程上有 14 次调用栈相同的重抛。CoroPerf 匹配各根 Task 实际保存的异常对象。在展示运行中，LaunchProfile 对应 12 次重抛，LaunchInventory 对应 2 次。

en.title: Which callers were waiting through the same poll?
en.summary: Both immediate Promises resolve before one 165 ms epoll_pwait2 in the selected run. Stock Inspector reaches the shared scheduler. CoroPerf matches each awaited Promise to its creation stack and recovers the original launcher for both delayed continuations.

zh-CN.title: 同一次轮询拖延了哪些调用者？
zh-CN.summary: 展示运行中，两个 immediate Promise 兑现后，协程都等了同一次 165 毫秒的 epoll_pwait2。原生 Inspector 能追到共享调度位置。CoroPerf 用每个 await 实际等待的 Promise 对象拼回创建栈，找回两条恢复栈各自的发起者。

en.title: Who triggered each replacement dial?
en.summary: The pool reports three open connections while the driver has zero. One goroutine processes the buffered replacement signals in order. CoroPerf matches each dial interval to the original send stack on the same channel, recovering the caller that discarded the connection.

zh-CN.title: 两次补拨分别由谁触发？
zh-CN.summary: 连接池报告有 3 个打开连接，驱动实际可用连接为 0。同一个 goroutine 依次处理缓冲区中的补拨信号。CoroPerf 将各次拨号区间接回同一通道上的发送栈，恢复触发补拨的调用者。

en.title: Who incurred the extra coroutine-frame allocation?
en.summary: Clang 19 makes a 48-byte heap allocation when Bar resumes. The destructor control embeds Baz inside Bar. Two extra allocations return the same child address. CoroPerf recovers the distinct parent frames from stripped machine code and joins each one to its original caller.

zh-CN.title: 哪个调用者引发了额外的协程帧分配？
zh-CN.summary: Clang 19 在 Bar 恢复时为 Baz 多做了一次 48 字节的堆分配，析构函数对照把 Baz 嵌在 Bar 帧中。两次额外分配返回同一个地址。CoroPerf 用去符号的机器码还原各自的父协程帧，再接回原始调用者。

en.title: Which caller delayed a ready task?
en.summary: A ready heartbeat waits through 102 retry attempts on the affected revision and 31 after the fix. Both retry futures have the same ordinary stack. The child poll intervals and push stacks assign 96 of the 102 attempts to launch_profile and six to launch_inventory in the displayed run.

zh-CN.title: 哪个调用者拖延了已就绪的任务？
zh-CN.summary: 修复前，已就绪的心跳要等 102 次重试，修复后只等 31 次。两个重试 Future 的普通栈相同。在展示的运行中，CoroPerf 用子节点轮询区间接回 push 的调用栈，将其中 96 次重试归到 launch_profile，另外 6 次归到 launch_inventory。

en.title: Who took the permit ahead of a queued waiter?
en.summary: On 3.10.3 the releasing task reacquires the permit while the woken waiter stays blocked. Joining each Task to the earlier dispatch Handle identifies both original callers. On 3.14.3 the queued task gets the next grant.

zh-CN.title: 谁越过排队的任务拿到了许可？
zh-CN.summary: 在 3.10.3 中，释放者再次取得许可，而已经被唤醒的任务继续等待。把两个 Task 分别接回实际的调度 Handle，可以找回原始调用者。在 3.14.3 中，先排队的任务拿到了下一次许可。

en.title: Which caller occupied the DNS worker?
en.summary: Two busy worker threads have the same stack. The resolver waits for the one in the default pool. The actual WorkItem and the broker's earlier queue request connect that worker to its original application caller.

zh-CN.title: 哪个调用者占用了 DNS 线程？
zh-CN.summary: 两个繁忙线程的物理栈相同。地址解析要等的是默认池里的线程。CoroPerf 用实际 WorkItem 和调度器更早取出的请求，把占用该线程的工作连回原始应用调用者。

en.title: Which callers submitted the stranded child futures?
en.summary: The stock task trace identifies the lock operations reached during the trace poll. After the children are stranded, it records no leaf stacks. CoroPerf matches the earlier leaf samples to the child nodes that were actually polled and recovers both original callers.

zh-CN.title: 两个卡住的子 Future 分别由谁提交？
zh-CN.summary: 原生任务追踪能看到触发问题时的两个锁操作。子 Future 卡住后，追踪无法取得新的叶子栈。CoroPerf 用实际被轮询的子节点归属先前记录的采样，再找回各自的提交者。

en.title: Who launched the coroutine reporting the old thread ID?
en.summary: Two resumes have identical symbolized GDB stacks and the same obsolete pthread ID. CoroPerf uses the stripped machine code to identify the actual frame from registers and stack bytes, then joins it to its recorded launch. Two independent batches each pass eight caller checks.

zh-CN.title: 打印旧线程 ID 的协程由谁发起？
zh-CN.summary: 两条带符号的 GDB 恢复栈完全相同，打印的也是同一个旧 pthread ID。CoroPerf 根据去符号后的机器码，从寄存器和栈字节定位实际协程帧，再接回它的创建栈。两个独立批次各通过 8 条调用者核对。

en.title: Who started the intervals that kept clearing timers?
en.summary: The released regression increases CPU time for 2,048 short intervals in the local benchmark. Both application entries share a spawn line and the same timer-clear stack. CoroPerf connects all 768 clear observations to the correct entry using each task's poll interval and creation stack.

zh-CN.title: 哪个入口启动了频繁清理定时器的任务？
zh-CN.summary: 本地 2,048 个短周期 interval 的测试复现了发布版 CPU 开销回归。两个应用入口共用一个 spawn 位置，执行中的清理栈也相同。CoroPerf 用活跃的 poll 区间和创建栈，将 768 次清理归到对应的启动入口。

en.title: Recovering the caller beyond a detached spawn
en.summary: Symbolized GDB shows the scheduler stack, and Asio's live awaiter chain stops at the detached boundary. From stripped machine code, register values and stack bytes, CoroPerf identifies the timer's active coroutine, then connects it through two recorded creation stacks to the original launcher.

zh-CN.title: 找回 detached spawn 之前的调用者
zh-CN.summary: 带符号的 GDB 显示调度器调用栈，Asio 的 awaiter 链止于 detached 边界。CoroPerf 从去符号的机器码、寄存器和栈字节确定定时器运行的是哪个协程，再沿两段创建栈接回原始入口。

en.title: Two callers, one CPU hot path
en.summary: In a V8 profiler adaptation, 603 ordinary samples showed the shared callee without either launch site. CoroPerf joined 579 independently checked samples to the correct launchProfile or launchInventory creation stack. The control reversed execution order.

zh-CN.title: 两个调用者，共享同一个 CPU 热点
zh-CN.summary: 在 V8 profiler 改编实验中，603 个普通样本只显示共享的被调用者。CoroPerf 把 579 个独立核对的观测分别接回 launchProfile 或 launchInventory 的创建栈。反转执行顺序后仍能正确区分。

en.title: Which caller delayed the socket read?
en.summary: Two CPU tasks have the same physical stack after suspension and the same stock spawn location. CoroPerf joins each poll to its creation stack. In this local adaptation, moving the same CPU work to a separate runtime changes median read delay from 107.924 ms to 0.039 ms.

zh-CN.title: 哪个调用者拖慢了 socket 读取？
zh-CN.summary: 两个 CPU 任务挂起后的物理栈相同，运行时给出的 spawn 位置也相同。CoroPerf 把各次 poll 接回各自的创建栈。在这个本地改编实验中，把同样的 CPU 工作移到独立运行时后，读取延迟中位数从 107.924 毫秒降到 0.039 毫秒。

en.title: Who submitted the blocking jobs with long queue waits?
en.summary: The stock span records show task IDs and the same submit and producer-spawn locations for both routes. CoroPerf connects the worker's CPU sample through blocking task creation to the async producer's earlier caller. All 1,036 samples match the independently recorded handle IDs.

zh-CN.title: 谁提交了排队慢的阻塞任务？
zh-CN.summary: 原生 span 能看到任务 ID，但两条路径的阻塞提交行和生产者启动行都相同。CoroPerf 把 worker 上的 CPU 样本经由阻塞任务的创建栈接回异步生产者的早期调用者。1,036 个样本均与独立记录的任务句柄 ID 相符。

en.title: Which request stalled in PostgreSQL?
en.summary: Two request entry points create instances of shared_lookup. In a stripped HTTP/PostgreSQL adaptation, instruction dataflow alone assigned zero of six external-wait samples. Observed activation bindings assigned six. Keeping creation history led all six samples back to the correct request origin.

zh-CN.title: 哪个请求卡在 PostgreSQL
zh-CN.summary: 两个请求入口都会创建 shared_lookup 的实例。在去符号的 HTTP/PostgreSQL 改编程序中，仅靠指令数据流，六份外部等待采样均无法归属。加入实际执行的激活绑定后，六份均归属成功。沿创建关系继续向上追溯，六份都找到了正确的请求入口。

en.title: Who spawned the delayed task?
en.summary: In the controlled scheduler replay, a helper stayed in a worker’s LIFO slot while the spawning worker was blocked. A spawn hook and the helper-body sample recorded the same process-local task ID. The joined stack recovers the parent and launch site of that delayed helper.

zh-CN.title: 谁创建了被延迟执行的任务
zh-CN.summary: 在受控复现中，创建任务的工作线程阻塞后，任务仍留在该工作线程的 LIFO 槽位。创建钩子和任务体样本记录了相同的进程内任务 ID。拼接可以把延迟执行的任务连回创建它的父任务及调用位置。
